titulo: Sadiq Khan fined by fast-track court over untaxed car City Hall says is not his
cuerpo: London mayor convicted under controversial system where magistrates can decide outcomes in seconds UK politics live – latest updates The London mayor, Sadiq Khan, has been convicted and fined for not taxing a 24-year-old car, through a controversial fast-track court system. He was found guilty last month under a system critics have described as “conveyor-belt justice”, with magistrates deciding on hundreds of daily cases and sometimes spending less than a minute on them.
